main_text.l: Nomina DD. Studiosorum, qui publicè quædam Specimina utriusque Lexici defenderunt.
I. DOMINICUS à VIANEN, Ultrajectinus, Anno 1686. 15. Septemb.
II. JOHANNES à CUYLENBORCH, Ultraj. 29. Septemb.
V. GYSBERTUS CONRADUS VOLMER, Winterswico-Gelrus, 15. Decemb.
VII. ARNOLDUS de BLANKENDAEL, Sylva-ducis-brab. defendit totum Lexicon Chaldaicum, 15. Martii, 1687.

page.notes: Faint engraving (decorative plate) behind entries II–III, not transcribed. Entry IV reads "Transisula-nus" as printed (likely Trajectinus/Transisulanus; kept as printed). Word-break hyphen in "Transisula-nus" and "Sylva-duc-brab." kept as printed; "Sylva-duc-brab" in the scan reads "Sylva-duc-brab." Greek/Hebrew: only the Hebrew signature mark at the foot, read as printed with uncertainty.
